questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped yellow signs mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns you of an upcoming right curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round yellow signs with black markings warn only about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a fluorescent yellow-green background. They warn about sharp turns and curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location. It is illegal to make a left turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and be prepared to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to others drivers.
Come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe.
Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means you must stop completely. Do not proceed until the red arrow is no longer shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns that the road will change direction sharply. Slow down and prepare for the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: As you approach a railroad crossing, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any trains pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mark work zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction areas. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards ahead. Orange signs typically indicate construction or maintenance work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows your lane splits into two directions. You can turn left or continue straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane will need to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you an intersection is ahead so you can prepare for traffic or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the right lane is ending and you should be ready for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Triangle signs pointing downward mean you must yield. Slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Stop at a marked line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to watch for bicycles crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a winding road with sharp curves ahead.
